final: WITH visit_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS visit_count FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), totals AS (SELECT SUM(visit_count) AS total_visits FROM visit_counts), shares AS (SELECT v.ID, v.visit_count, CAST(v.visit_count AS REAL) / t.total_visits AS share FROM visit_counts AS v JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_visits IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT s.ID, s.visit_count, s.share, s.share - a.average_share AS share_above_average FROM shares AS s JOIN averages AS a ON a.average_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.average_share ORDER BY share_above_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
